# KIKO App (LLM Index)

KIKO is a chat-first Web3 trading assistant UI.

Primary routes:
- / (Welcome + Chat)
- /chat/:conversationId
- /tokens
- /tokens/:chain/:address
- /trade
- /wallet
- /settings
- /market
- /chains
- /social
- /news
- /defi/*

Agent mode:
- URL override: ?agent_mode=1 or ?agent_mode=0
- Settings toggle: Settings -> Automation -> For Agent Mode

Machine-readable runtime:
- /agent-map.json (live DOM agent map)
- window.__KIKO_AGENT_MAP__ (in-page snapshot)

Data contract (node attrs):
- data-agent-id
- data-agent-role
- data-agent-action
- data-agent-page
- data-agent-key

High-value flows:
- Chat command execution
- Trade strategy edit / pause / delete
- Wallet quick actions (send/receive/swap)
- Token detail quick buy/sell entry

See /llms-full.txt for full action semantics and examples.
